chapter: Bird, the band's breakup and Luis Russell
title: Personnel changes: Jimmy Forrest, Paul Quinichette and Bird
summary: Players quit in Kansas City; they added Jimmy Forrest and Paul Quinichette, and Walter Brown and Paul got arrested in San Antonio.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So that's when Bird -- I'd say -- officially left himself. That's when we picked up Jimmy Forest. We came back into New York again. No, we had to send for Jimmy Forest. We had heard Jimmy Forest the summer before; when Bob Mabane had to go into the service, we picked up Jimmy Forest.
Now, when we got out to Dallas again, then we --
Quinette that's when we picked up Paul Pinochet. And about that time Bird rejoined us. We got down to San Antonio, and I think Paul and what's his name got arrested.
Paul and Walter Brown got arrested.
Bird was lucky enough. They were out there in the field picking that stuff.
And so Bird was slick enough to get away. So anyway, we came on back into New York.
